subject: Demo reschedule — Budget timing & Q4 spend freeze
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nate Porter <nate.porter@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 30 / mutual action plan

Hi Nate —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, I'd like to lock in a 60-minute demo of Redwood's inference platform next week so we can walk through: model catalog, latency/cost controls, and Dedicated deployment options.

Proposed time: Tue, Nov 30 at 10:00 AM PT (I've penciled this on our end). If that doesn't work, please suggest 1-2 alternatives.

I've attached a quick mutual action plan to make approvals easier on your side (outline of stakeholders, required artifacts, and a suggested timeline).

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (stub)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Nate Porter <nate.porter@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 30 / mutual action plan

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the follow-up and the MAP. Quick update from our side: leadership just announced a temporary spend freeze and a hiring/travel pause through the end of the quarter while we finalize FY27 budgets. That means we likely won't be able to move forward with new vendor evaluations or POs until after the budget reset in early January.

I travel the week of Nov 29 as well, so Nov 30 won't work. Procurement looped me in on approvals (cc'd).

Two asks: 1) can we move the demo to after your Jan 4-15 window? 2) in the meantime, could you share a condensed 20-30 minute recording or a one-pager we can circulate internally so the stakeholders get context before January?

Thanks,
Nate Porter
Head of Platform Engineering
Nimbus Analytics

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nate Porter <nate.porter@nimbus-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:20:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 30 / mutual action plan

Thanks for the update, Nate — completely understand.

We can do either of the following:
- Hold a 30-minute internal alignment call in early December (no decision needed) just to surface questions to your procurement/finance team, or
- Push the full 60-minute demo to the week of Jan 11 (we can reserve a couple of slots now and release them if something changes).

I'll attach the one-pager and a shorter demo recording for you to share. If you prefer we keep it dark until Jan, we can also set tentative options and follow up after your budget reset.

Attachments: demo-one-pager.pdf (stub), short-demo-recording-link.txt (link to internal recording)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 30 / mutual action plan

Internal note — looped in since this looks like an FY timing pause. Two tactical asks:
1) Mark the opportunity as 'hold — budget timing' in HubSpot (DEAL-4821). I'll add a note to set a reminder for Jan 4 to re-engage.
2) Offer two sets of tentative demo slots (canary + backup): Jan 4-8 (canary) and Jan 11-15 (primary). If they confirm early, great; if not, we'll push follow-ups after Jan 4.

Also suggest we include a small reserved-demo credit (30-min consult) to keep the relationship warm — can be offered without contract. Laura, can you prepare the one-pager + 25-minute digest version of the demo for Nate to circulate? Marissa, I'll backstop escalation if procurement pushes on the SOW in December.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Nate Porter <nate.porter@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:02:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 30 / mutual action plan

Marissa/Laura —

Thanks for the flexibility. Jan 11 (anytime after 10:00 AM PT) should work well for our execs. Procurement will restart approvals the week of Jan 4. We'll hold off on any signatures until the FY reset, but please go ahead and send the one-pager and the short recording link so I can share with the team.

Also—Procurement asked whether you can provide an abbreviated SOW and a redacted example of a procurement redline so their legal team can pre-clear language before January. If you can send that as a stub (we don't need signatures now), that would help speed approvals.

I can confirm a firm time the week of Jan 4 once calendars reopen.

Best,
Nate
